function.name: invite_link
function.description: Sends a message with an interactive inline button containing an invite/join URL to a Google Classroom course. Call this tool when the teacher or student asks for a course join link, wants to share an enrollment URL, or needs to provide a clickable button to connect to a class.

url.description: The direct HTTP(S) link for joining or opening the course (e.g., Google Classroom alternateLink or enrollment link).

text.description: The accompanying text/message explaining what the link is for (e.g., 'Перейдите по кнопке ниже, чтобы подключиться к курсу').
